title: Summer music festival
instructions: Radyoda bir müzik festivalinin tanıtımı. Uzun bir metin; günler, fiyatlar ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Good news for music fans! The Riverside Music Festival is back this summer, from Friday the eleventh to Sunday the thirteenth of July.

script.speaker: host
script.text: This year, there are more than forty bands on three stages.

script.speaker: host
script.text: The biggest name, The Moonlights, will play on Saturday night, not Friday as planned.

script.speaker: host
script.text: A ticket for one day is forty-five pounds. A weekend ticket for all three days is one hundred pounds.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Children under twelve are free, but they must be with an adult.

script.speaker: host
script.text: You can camp at the festival, but you need to bring your own tent. There are showers, but there's often a long queue!

script.speaker: host
script.text: You can't bring glass bottles or your own alcohol. There are food stalls from many countries.

script.speaker: host
script.text: There will be free buses from the train station every twenty minutes.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Tickets go on sale this Monday at ten a.m. on the festival website.
